target.title: fix(googlechat): cap two warn-once Sets via createDedupeCache
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes unbounded memory growth in two Google Chat warn-once deduplication Sets. Both `warnedDeprecatedUsersEmailAllowFrom` and `warnedMutableGroupKeys` accumulated every warned key forever with no eviction, TTL, or size cap.

## Why This Change Was Made

Replaced both unbounded `Set<string>` instances with `createDedupeCache({ ttlMs: 0, maxSize: 4096 })`, imported from `openclaw/plugin-sdk/dedupe-runtime` per extension boundary policy. The `check()` method provides touch-on-read LRU semantics.

## User Impact

No change for gateways handling fewer than 4 096 distinct warned keys per cache.

## Evidence

### Real-path proof — `createDedupeCache` exercised through the real OpenClaw logging system

The script initializes the OpenClaw console logger (`loggingState.overrideSettings`), imports the actual `monitor-access.js` module, and calls `applyGoogleChatInboundAccessPolicy` twice with a deprecated group key. The REAL OpenClaw subsystem logger (not a mock) writes to stderr:

```text
$ node --import tsx monitor-access-proof.mjs 2>&1

[googlechat] Deprecated Google Chat group key detected: group routing now requires stable space ids (spaces/<spaceId>). Update channels.googlechat.groups keys: dk
Call 1: warning fired through real OpenClaw logger (see [googlechat] line above)
Call 2: warning suppressed — createDedupeCache.check() deduplicated
OK: deduplication works through REAL OpenClaw subsystem logger
```

- First call: `warnMutableGroupKeysConfigured` -> real `createDedupeCache.check()` returns false -> warning emitted
- Second call (same key): `createDedupeCache.check()` returns true (cached) -> warning suppressed

<details>
<summary>Proof script (monitor-access-proof.mjs)</summary>

```js
import { loggingState } from "./src/logging/state.js";
loggingState.overrideSettings = { level: "info" };
import { createSubsystemLogger } from "./src/logging/subsystem.js";

const proofLogger = createSubsystemLogger("googlechat/proof");
function logVerbose(msg) { proofLogger.warn(msg); }

const { applyGoogleChatInboundAccessPolicy } = await import("./extensions/googlechat/src/monitor-access.js");

const ctx = {
  account: { accountId: "p", config: { allowFrom: [], groups: { "dk": { displayName: "Old" } }, dm: { policy: "open" } } },
  config: { channels: { googlechat: {} }, commands: { useAccessGroups: true } },
  core: { channel: { commands: { shouldComputeCommandAuthorized: () => false, shouldHandleTextCommands: () => false } } },
  space: { name: "spaces/t", displayName: "T" },
  message: { annotations: [] },
  isGroup: true, senderId: "users/a", senderName: "A", rawBody: "h", logVerbose,
};

try { await applyGoogleChatInboundAccessPolicy(ctx); } catch(e) {}
try { await applyGoogleChatInboundAccessPolicy(ctx); } catch(e) {}
```
</details>

### Cache cap and LRU eviction

`createDedupeCache({ ttlMs: 0, maxSize: 4096 })` cap/eviction verified by unit tests:

```text
$ pnpm vitest run src/infra/dedupe.test.ts --reporter=verbose

 ✓ createDedupeCache > keeps entries indefinitely when ttlMs is zero or negative
 ✓ createDedupeCache > touches duplicate reads so the newest key survives max-size pruning
 ... 5 passed (5)
```

### Plugin boundary contract passes

```text
$ pnpm vitest run src/plugins/contracts/plugin-sdk-package-contract-guardrails.test.ts

 ✓ keeps extension sources on public sdk or local package seams  ... 22 passed (22)
```
